description_en: Queries whether the current WAF instance is under a DDoS attack
kebab_example: aliyun waf-openapi describe-ddos-status --instance-id waf_v3prepaid_public_cn-000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --api-version 2021-10-01 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeDDoSStatus

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the WAF instance.
You can call https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html to query the ID of the current WAF instance
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例的ID。
您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/433756.html查询当前WAF实例的ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The region where the WAF instance is deployed. Valid values:

cn-hangzhou: the Chinese mainland.

ap-southeast-1: outside the Chinese mainland
parameters.help_zh:
WAF实例所属地域。取值：

cn-hangzhou：表示中国内地。

ap-southeast-1：表示非中国内地
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The Alibaba Cloud resource group ID
parameters.name: resource_manager_resource_group_id

EventType.description_en:
The event type. Valid values:
defense: DDoS scrubbing events.
blackhole: DDoS blackhole filtering events
EventType.description_zh:
事件类型名称。可能值：
defense：DDoS清洗事件。
blackhole：DDoS黑洞事件

Status.description_en:
The DDoS status. Valid values:
doing: under DDoS attack
